---
name: summary-writer
description: Writes a dated summary for every meeting transcript it is handed. Use when a transcript is pasted in, when the user asks what a meeting decided, or when the week has to be wrapped up before Friday.
---

# Summary writer

1. Read the transcript the user pasted. Stop if it holds no dialogue.
2. Pick out every decision, and the person who owns each one.
3. Tell the user what you found, in the order the decisions were taken.
4. Answer any follow-up question from the same transcript rather than asking for it
   to be pasted again.
